arguments.value: Covington, Virginia Maria Hernandez is a United States District Judge for the Middle District of Florida, assuming senior status in 2020 after serving on the court since her confirmation in 2004. Born in Tampa, Florida, she earned her B.S. and M.B.A. from the University of Tampa and her J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center. She began her legal career as a trial attorney with the Federal Trade Commission, then served as an assistant state attorney in Florida and as an assistant U.S. attorney in the Middle District of Florida, where she held roles in the Civil Division and later as chief of the Asset Forfeiture Section. Before joining the federal bench, she served as a judge on Florida’s Second District Court of Appeal from 2001 to 2004.
